# checks that it agrees with pyproject.toml, because these two files had already drifted

# the opposite.

# The hard pins on the numeric stack are deliberate: the serving bundle is a pickle of
# fitted sklearn objects, and loading a 1.8.0 pickle on a 1.7.x runtime warns that it
# "might lead to breaking code or invalid results".
